scope: Original Windows x64 applications; own kernel/runtime; M15 Windows x86, M16 Win16/DOS remain separate

stages.title: Original targets and baseline
stages.deliver: Pin original packages, inspect installer/payload/custom-action architectures, inventory static dependencies and native gaps, and freeze functional/performance protocols.
stages.how_and_why: Read-only PE/MSI analysis and exact source references avoid guessing from an x64 download label. Do not execute downloaded apps on the development host.
stages.acceptance: Version/hash inventory, installation-chain decisions, per-app task corpus, bounded performance protocol, source/native baseline, honest unknowns and complete public research delivery.

stages.title: Win64 loader and DLL environment
stages.deliver: Extend checked PE32+ mapping, relocations, imports/forwarders/delay imports, module lifetime and dependencies.
stages.how_and_why: Replace the current fixed eight-module/eight-MiB assumptions with explicit tested per-process quotas and demand-backed mappings, not unbounded allocations.
stages.acceptance: Original selected binaries load correctly with access violations, invalid images and missing required functions refused clearly; no GUI compatibility claim from loading alone.

stages.title: Processes, threads and exceptions
stages.deliver: Provide real Windows thread/TLS/wait/timer/exception behavior and child-process lifetime over isolated native processes.
stages.how_and_why: The existing one-thread console profile cannot safely substitute fake synchronization or success stubs for real behavior.
stages.acceptance: Concurrent original tasks and child processes behave correctly; faults/cancellation remain contained; repeated close releases owned resources.

stages.title: Files, paths and persistent settings
stages.deliver: Expand Unicode/case/path/share/delete/locking semantics, temporary files, environment and registry behavior.
stages.how_and_why: Translate Windows expectations to native storage with explicit access grants; keep user data separate from product ownership.
stages.acceptance: Selected app preferences/files survive independent starts; conflicting access and missing/denied paths return correct errors without corrupting data.

stages.title: Original Windows windows and messages
stages.deliver: Implement the required USER32 window/message/focus/input model and connect it to the native compositor.
stages.how_and_why: Run original application code and its actual message loop rather than recreate the target app as a native lookalike.
stages.acceptance: Original app windows visibly respond to input, focus, move/resize/minimize/close; ownership and modality do not operate the wrong app.
stages.publication_status: Complete under explicit owner scope: missing BrixCanvas documentation search/navigation is reported and nonblocking; native/media/download/content checks pass

stages.title: Drawing, text and common controls
stages.deliver: Implement required GDI/text/resources/menu/control/dialog behavior for the pinned applications.
stages.how_and_why: Share native drawing/fonts where semantics match, with bounded surfaces and dirty-region repaint; provider/name presence is not semantic compatibility.
stages.acceptance: Readable working original app interfaces at ordinary and named HiDPI profiles, with pixel and behavior evidence; no vendor GPU/DirectX claim.
stages.publication_status: Complete within explicit owner scope; advanced platform search/navigation remains reported, nonblocking and unqualified

stages.title: Open, save and clipboard interoperability
stages.deliver: Connect original app file dialogs, clipboard and actual document access with Files.
stages.how_and_why: Preserve requesting-window ownership and file semantics; original app data must be checked independently.
stages.acceptance: Open/edit/save/reopen, Unicode names, cancel and cross-app text clipboard tasks pass without lost or misdirected data.

stages.title: Reusable MSI execution
stages.deliver: Implement the selected packages' actual MSI standard actions, conditions/properties/component lifecycle, rollback and required custom actions.
stages.how_and_why: Replace the current one-digest console adapter with reusable behavior. Notepad++ MSI requires a real x64 WiX custom-action DLL and cmd/xcopy semantics; never skip it to claim successful installation.
stages.acceptance: Selected original MSI packages install/remove/reinstall correctly, including conditions, cancellation and fault recovery; missing mandatory actions refuse clearly.

stages.title: Original x64 EXE installers
stages.deliver: Execute pinned original AMD64 installer code, its GUI and required helpers/uninstaller.
stages.how_and_why: SumatraPDF provides a measured x64 route. The measured Notepad++ x64-labelled EXE is x86 and explicitly waits for M15; its original x64 MSI remains an M14 target.
stages.acceptance: At least one complete original x64 EXE installer chain and original MSI chains work; all required child binaries are inventoried and exercised.

stages.title: Native desktop integration
stages.deliver: Publish real installed app icons, Start/taskbar entries, shortcuts, file associations and Open with behavior.
stages.how_and_why: Keep a single native desktop with lazy compatibility services and independently removable applications.
stages.acceptance: Apps launch from normal desktop routes without a terminal; icon/focus/grouping/association behavior is correct and removal leaves the base usable.

stages.title: Required runtimes and COM
stages.deliver: Implement or deliberately integrate the exact required runtime/API/COM contracts with provenance and versioned dependency records.
stages.how_and_why: Start from measured dependencies. Optional plugin/updater/shell-extension and .NET/Electron/WebView2/DirectX families are separate profiles, never implied by PE loading.
stages.acceptance: Required target dependencies actually work; no fake success or silent omission. Deferred optional features remain visible in the compatibility matrix.

stages.title: Removal, repair and reinstall
stages.deliver: Exercise original removal paths and ownership-aware cleanup, changed files, interrupted install/remove and repair.
stages.how_and_why: Deleting application-owned unchanged files must not remove user documents, shared required components or the OS.
stages.acceptance: Install/use/remove/reinstall and fault retries preserve independently checked user data and release owned processes, files and resources.

stages.title: Complete original-app scenarios
stages.deliver: Run the frozen exact-app functional corpus through original installation, launch, use, save, restart, removal and reinstall.
stages.how_and_why: A copied payload, version banner or single window is insufficient. Record installed, launchable, usable and task performance separately.
stages.acceptance: All three registered app/version/task profiles pass their mandatory tasks, or M14 remains incomplete; scope revisions require explicit documented owner direction.

stages.title: Performance and failure qualification
stages.deliver: Measure CPU time, input/presentation latency, peak/retained memory, storage requests/bytes/flushes and app/OS fault containment.
stages.how_and_why: Compare repeated complete workloads and idle periods with the frozen protocol; count host, kernel, compatibility and application costs separately.
stages.acceptance: No unexplained retention or idle polling; declared limits and critical regressions resolved; saves remain durable and the desktop remains responsive.

stages.title: Release candidate and public rehearsal
stages.deliver: Freeze candidate source/media, verify installation/startup and full current app/desktop regressions, docs, downloads and website.
stages.how_and_why: This is an explicit release candidate, not the final M14 release. Its public label must state that M14.15 is still blocking.
stages.acceptance: Matching tested candidate and complete public rehearsal delivered; no final performance claim, final tag or automatic advancement around M14.15.

stages.title: Mandatory whole-system optimization and final release
stages.deliver: Optimize CPU, RAM and HDD/SSD traffic across the entire OS and every qualified Windows app; repeat the same exact functional and performance corpus on frozen final bytes.
stages.how_and_why: Measure cold/warm starts, real CPU time, cache/resident/commit/shared memory, physical and logical I/O and drained writeback. Fix causes instead of hiding work in caches or delayed writes.
stages.acceptance: Functional correctness, resource budgets and no-regression gates all pass; publish measurements and limits, exact final ISO/VMware media, English guides, GitHub and complete actual website verification. Only now release final M14.
